Embedding produces BF16 hidden states. Profile F rms returns BF16 inputs for the merged layer.qkv projection through linear3. Model::rope and Q scaling cast back to BF16; Model::repeat_kv prepares K/V for precision::attention. The returned BF16 context is transposed, materialized and reshaped for the layer.out projection. BF16 residual addition and rms feed layer.gate_up; profile F silu_mul returns BF16 for layer.down. Residuals remain BF16. After final rms, token states are explicitly widened to F32.
Pools and L2-normalizes using tensor elementwise/reduction operations, then retrieves F32 output to host; introduces no additional GEMM.
Runs the decoder and averages valid token states by sum and affine operations; no additional GEMM.

Creates a new manifest, performs a further math check when constructing the startup record, optionally records the supplied attestation string, and writes, flushes and syncs that record before returning an executor retaining the model and guard. It neither acquires the guard nor creates the CUDA device, and does not validate the attestation string's syntax or authenticity.
Writes a JSON record and newline, flushes and syncs data; errors propagate.

Rejects poisoned executors and validates the whole logical request before execution. Sets poisoned=true before operational work and clears it only after complete success; operational errors and unwinding panics leave it poisoned.

Executes one physical sequence at a time, checks flags before each forward and after host output retrieval, validates output, and records begin/end manifests. Returned errors do not yield a successful partial response. No-overlap with external device/stream users is still an operational restriction.
